Izumi Seinikuten / Courses & prices

Courses & prices

Every course runs 120 minutes, with orders taken for the first 90. Prices are per person, tax included. Courses are for two or more guests, and everyone at the table takes the same course.

Course details

  1. Pork & Chickenよかコース（Yoka）

    “Yoka” = good

    Yakiniku (pork & chicken)
    Pork kalbi, pork jowl, pork shoulder loin, sausage, chicken thigh, chicken neck, chicken liver, gizzard, chicken tail, breast cartilage
    Salads, kimchi & namul
    Five salads, cabbage kimchi, cucumber kimchi, radish kimchi, assorted namul, edamame, grilled vegetables, Korean seaweed
    Rice & soups
    Steamed rice, gukbap (rice soup), yukgaejang spicy soup, egg soup, seaweed soup, two kinds of sundubu stew
    Cold noodles & bibimbap
    Cold noodles with steamed chicken or roast beef, spicy bibim noodles, hot-stone bibimbap (three kinds)
    Side dishes
    Korean pancake, seafood pancake, two pizzas, fried chicken, french fries, garlic in oil
    Dessert
    Yuzu gelato, vanilla gelato, ice cream with brown sugar syrup and kinako, sesame dumplings, matcha dessert

    ¥2,980

All-you-can-drink

An all-you-can-drink plan can be added for an extra charge; our staff will explain the plans and prices at the restaurant. You can also order drinks one at a time.

House rules

  • 120 minutes in total. Orders are taken for the first 90 minutes.
  • Everyone at the table takes the same course.
  • At last order, each guest may order one dish and one drink.
  • A charge applies if a large amount of food is left uneaten.
  • Chicken sashimi is limited to one plate per person.
  • Discounts are available for children and guests aged 65 and over. Please ask by phone.

Questions & answers

Which courses include beef tongue and wagyu?

Beef tongue and wagyu premium kalbi, misuji and loin are all-you-can-eat in the Wazze course (¥5,980). The tasting of two Kagoshima wagyu steaks is included from the Oyattosa course (¥4,480).

Is there an all-you-can-drink option?

Yes, for an extra charge. Our staff will explain the plans and prices at the restaurant. Drinks can also be ordered one at a time.

Are there any extra charges?

Course prices include tax. All-you-can-drink is extra, and a charge applies if a large amount of food is left uneaten.

Can people at the same table choose different courses?

No. Everyone at the table takes the same course.

Reserve by phone. Same-day tables can be checked, too.

Phone lines open at 16:00. Courses are for two or more guests; table-only reservations are accepted from one guest.
